name: Shadow Magic
summary: Marshal Marris needs the midnight orbs taken from Blackrock shadowcasters in Redridge. Their dark power threatens Lakeshire's defenders and the town's line.

sections.title: A Sinister Arsenal
sections.body: The Blackrock clan has long relied on brute force. Now its raids in the Redridge Mountains bring a darker threat. Shadowcasters wield dark powers and channel fel and shadow energies through demon-tainted midnight orbs. These relics have dealt terrible losses to the local militia, and the war is turning against the defenders.

sections.title: Containing the Taint
sections.body: Marshal Marris directs Lakeshire's strained defense from the town center. He knows ordinary steel cannot easily overcome dark relics. If Blackrock orcs keep their midnight orbs, Redridge's eastern borders may collapse. Marris orders the shadowcasters slain and the orbs seized, so the demonic relics can be destroyed instead of put to use.

faq.answer: Midnight orbs are demon-tainted conduits carried by Blackrock shadowcasters. They focus dark magic into devastating blows against Redridge's mortal defenders.

faq.q: Why does Marshal Marris want these orbs?
faq.answer: Marshal Marris wants the orbs taken from the battlefield to cripple the Blackrock shadowcasters' offensive power. He plans to have the demonic relics safely disposed of and destroyed.
Blackrock shadowcasters are orcish spellcasters who wield shadow and fel-tainted magic. They support the clan's brute warriors with magical artillery and curses.
Blackrock shadowcasters hold camps and fortified positions throughout the northeastern Redridge Mountains.

faq.q: Will Lakeshire study or use the orbs?
aliases: can the alliance use the orbs
faq.answer: No. Marshal Marris considers the orbs dangerous and demon-tainted, and says the world would be better off without them. He wants them destroyed at once.

faq.q: Why is demonic magic appearing in Redridge?
faq.answer: The Blackrock clan has consorted with dark and fel entities since the days of the Old Horde. Its spellcasters still use demonic relics and shadow magic to bolster the clan's conquests.

angles.text: Lakeshire is on the brink of being overrun, with virtually no reinforcements from Stormwind. Depriving the Blackrock clan of its dark artillery is crucial to the region's survival.
As a warlock, you can see the Blackrock clan's enduring fel roots in the midnight orbs and the raw demonic channeling used by orcish spellcasters.
As a paladin, confronting shadowcasters and securing demon-tainted relics fulfills your holy duty to purge demonic corruption from the mortal realm.
